name: Bulk Image Resizer with Format Conversion

seo.title: Bulk Image Resizer with Format Conversion — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Resize a bounded batch of images with contain/cover/stretch modes and optionally convert formats before ZIP download.

assumptions: Processing is sequential with cancellation to limit peak memory.
limitations: Animated inputs are treated as still images unless the animation-specific tools are used.
